actual_fit_time: record actual wallclock separately; never backdate model freeze

drift.anchor: latest genuine row at/before latest_capture-24h, within6h before boundary
drift.sampling: latest genuine capture/id in each UTC hour

benchmark_recipe.offline_pickup_weights: equal total weight perfixture within sourcefamily/h/maturitycell; same5/3gate

pickup.median: smallest observed delta with cumulative weight>=0.5 total, no interpolation

candidate.preprocessing: fixed12 numeric features, null->NaN, no fitted imputation/scaling
candidate.selection: one real fit, no hyperparameter search or historical accuracy-based selection
candidate.target: future observed availability-last actual observed availability

data_evidence.completed_confirmation: identity+confirmation/availability clocks only, never actual attendance values
data_evidence.evaluation: only genuinely future immutable forecasts and later original receipts
data_evidence.exposure: all old fixtures remain exposed; no fresh holdout claim
data_evidence.labels: latest real capture<=origin+h within6h, afterorigin/beforekickoff, no intervening measurement transition or invalid source state
data_evidence.origins: first actual capture perUTCday plus first actual capture of each segment, selected before labels
data_evidence.source_scope: last contiguous exact measurement-key segment at each origin; retain older incompatible segments in catalogue

feature_semantics.horizon_hours: during live inference nominal issue horizon+latest source staleness (actual elapsed from last capture); capture-aligned training age=0

mechanism_audit.rule: fixed synthetic rising/flat/falling prefixes with same last level at horizons24/48/72; count value-history feature splits; no retune if degenerate

prospective.input_clock: actual original receipt-bound metadata and observations known by actual issue
prospective.paired_baselines: same actual issue/input/target and frozen later actual label
prospective.source_segment_rule: only current contiguous comparable segment; preserve all older raw segments and scopechange lineage
